description: This file defines the CloudFrontClient class within the AWS SDK for PHP. The class provides methods for interacting with Amazon CloudFront service, including generating signed URLs and cookies for private distributions, and includes a comprehensive list of API methods and documentation.

classes.name: CloudFrontClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with the Amazon CloudFront service, including URL and cookie signing functionalities.

methods.name: getSignedUrl
methods.description: Generates a signed CloudFront URL based on provided options such as URL, key pair ID, private key, expiration, and policy.

methods.name: getSignedCookie
methods.description: Creates signed cookies for CloudFront distribution access based on options like URL, key pair ID, private key, expiration, and policy.
